scenario_description:
Objective: Finish clearing the lower driveway lane so the afternoon propane truck can reach the tank without rescheduling.
Emerging Need: The clearing run has begun, but the snowblower stops crosswise at the switchback and the lane cannot be cleared or reopened unaided.
Decision Context: Stored snow-access notes distinguish safe owner limits, driveway hazards, and the routine plow/tractor route from repair or towing guesses; live notices define remaining add-on time.
Consequence: If the add-on board closes, the blower stays in the travel lane and the propane stop loses usable access this afternoon.

parameter.subject: Propane truck confirmed for East Hill loop today
parameter.body: Today's East Hill loop includes your cabin stop between 15:00 and 16:00. Driver notes still require the lower drive to be opened wide enough for the bobtail to reach the tank lane; uncleared switchbacks will be skipped and rescheduled.

parameter.title: Clear lower driveway for propane access
parameter.description: Open the lower switchback and tank-lane approach before the afternoon propane route.

parameter.content: From the road I can see you've got the first two snowblower passes cut. The south berm at the switchback is still wind-packed, so the truck lane is not open all the way through yet.

I heard the snap and now the tracked snowblower is stopped sideways at the lower switchback. The auger is still packed, both tracks are not freewheeling, and there isn't room to clear around it with the lane half-open.

parameter.subject: Midday snow-route openings for 20 Jan
parameter.body: A tractor/plow unit still has one East Hill add-on opening before the afternoon propane and oil-delivery traffic. The route board closes at 13:15; equipment-in-lane recoveries remain routine add-ons only while today's board is open.

parameter.subject: Snow-route board closed for 20 Jan
parameter.body: Same-day routine add-ons closed at 13:15. Crews are now limited to active no-exit emergencies and municipal callbacks; the next ordinary driveway recovery slot on East Hill is tomorrow morning.
